notes:
Editor found one blocking issue: set-before-after doesn't fit the Mario theme and must be replaced with an on-theme set; set-taxonomic needs a word swap and difficulty tweak per editor's own note. Both are fixable at the pair-author stage since new/changed pairs are needed.
- set-before-after: Editor says this puzzle seemingly has nothing to do with Nintendo/Mario despite passing the analogy validator.
  Try: Replace with Mario-themed before/after pair, e.g. 'Egg : Yoshi' and 'Acorn : Buzzy Beetle'-style growth pairs — but must be canon Mario, e.g. 'Seed : Piranha Plant' (sprout to grown plant) paired with 'Dawn : Nightfall' replaced by a Mario day-cycle equivalent, or simplest: replace both pairs with Mario-specific spans such as 'Egg : Yoshi' (hatch to grown) and 'Cocoon : Butterfly'-analog like 'Question Block : Item' (before/after of one triggered span) — needs pair-author to find true Mario-canon before/after pairs.
  Or: Alternative: keep the abstract relationship but reskin with recognizable Mario moments, e.g. 'Small Mario : Super Mario' (before/after of one power-up span) and 'Goomba : Stomped Goomba' — send to pair-author to vet against failureMode (span must be unambiguous).
Do not change: set-recipient-instrument, set-cause-effect — these were approved.
